The making of a piece

From timber yard to your living room

Four stages under one roof, from the first log to the final placement.

  1. Season the timber

    Sheesham and mango wood are air-dried, then kiln-finished to a moisture level that keeps joints tight through the Haryana summer and winter.

    • Sheesham & mango wood
    • Air-dried, then kiln-finished

  2. Cut the joinery

    Mortise-and-tenon and dovetail joints, glued and pinned. The frame holds together by its joints, with no staples doing the work.

    • Dovetail drawers
    • Through-tenon shelves

  3. Finish by hand

    Sanded through four grits, stained to your sample and sealed with a hand-rubbed finish. Bring a swatch and we will match it.

    • Stain matched to your sample
    • Hand-rubbed seal

  4. Deliver and place

    Our team delivers, assembles and places each piece in your room, then takes the packaging away with them.

    • Assembly included
    • Haryana & Delhi NCR

Home/About
Our story

Made slowly, made to last

We are a workshop and showroom in Karnal. We build furniture the way it was built when a table was expected to outlive its owner.

The workshop

A bench, a lathe and a lot of patience

Our carpenters learned their trade from fathers and uncles, and most have worked together for over a decade. They choose the planks, cut the joints and sign off every piece before it leaves.

The showroom on Kunjpura Road is where you meet the work. Sit on it, open the drawers, ask the questions. Then we build yours.

How we got here

A short timeline

2009

A single bench

Two carpenters and one workbench, building beds and wardrobes for neighbours in Karnal.

2014

The first showroom

Customers wanted to sit on a sofa before ordering it. We opened a small room to show finished pieces.

2019

Offices and designers

Made-to-measure workstations and a trade desk for interior designers across the region.

2024

Kunjpura Road

A larger showroom with full room sets, a fabric library and a finishing studio you can visit.

What we stand for

Four promises

Seasoned wood

Timber is dried before it is cut, so doors close and drawers slide in every season.

Honest joinery

Joints do the holding. You can see them, and you can repair them in thirty years.

Made to measure

Any piece can be resized or re-finished to fit your room and your taste.

After-sale care

A five-year frame warranty and a team that comes back if something needs fixing.

Before you visit

Common questions

Do I need an appointment?

No. Walk in any time during opening hours. If you want a designer’s full attention, message us a day ahead and we will set a time aside.

Can any piece be made to a different size?

Yes. Most pieces can be resized, re-finished or re-covered. Send us your room measurements and we will return a drawing and a quote.

How long does delivery take?

Showroom pieces are usually ready in a few days. Made-to-order pieces take three to five weeks, and we confirm the date when you place the order.

Do you deliver outside Karnal?

We deliver across Haryana, Punjab and Delhi NCR, with assembly included. Ask about other cities.

Do you offer trade pricing for designers?

Yes. Interior designers and architects get trade pricing, sample finishes and custom drawings. Mention your studio when you enquire.
